dining.description: Fresh Maldivian flavours served with island views, in a dining room inspired by local lacquer art.

notices.transfer: Speedboat schedules to/from Maamigili airport can shift with weather and sea conditions. Please confirm your transfer time with reception the evening before departure.
notices.rules: Guest rules: no smoking indoors, quiet hours 22:00–07:00. Swimwear is welcome at Bikini Beach and the house reef — please dress modestly elsewhere on the island out of respect for local custom.

intro.title: Cozy Arts
intro.welcome: We are happy to have you with us. Use this guest guide for everything you need during your stay — hotel information, dining times, activities, transport and local recommendations.
intro.about: A colourful, art-inspired guest house on Dhangethi in South Ari Atoll, celebrating local Maldivian craft and lacquer-work heritage — with whale sharks, manta rays and sandbanks just a short boat ride away.

diving.title: Dive South Ari Atoll
diving.description: From reef dives to manta cleaning stations, our dive partner Cozy Scuba Club will match a site to your experience level.
